title: Board-Adopted Refund Interest Provision for Meter Overbilling on Electric Service by Rate Schedule Accounts
content:
**Provision.** Where a fast meter has overbilled an Electric Service by Rate Schedule account, interest is added for the length of the overbilling, measured by the number of billed energy charge lines the rebill window covers on the service account:

| Billed energy charge lines in the rebill window | Interest |
|---|---|
| Six or more | 1.84 percent |
| Three, four or five | 0.92 percent |
| Two or fewer | None |

**Base and rounding.** The interest increases the meter error refund together with the late charge refund, the late charge refund being added to the meter error refund before the interest is applied. The increased sum is the sum multiplied by one plus the interest percent in hundredths, rounded to the cent.

### Hypothetical figures (meter error refund $30.00 and late charge refund $0.23, together $30.23)

| Energy lines in the window | Increased sum |
|---|---|
| 6 | $30.23 multiplied by 1.0184 is $30.7862, rounded to $30.79 |
| 3 | $30.23 multiplied by 1.0092 is $30.5081, rounded to $30.51 |
| 2 | $30.23, no interest |

### Points of reading

- The count is of energy charge lines, one per billed period, dated in the rebill window of the same service account.
- Five lines earn 0.92 percent; the 1.84 percent rate begins at six.
